profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Tech Mahindra
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer, Agile development group lead, and Windows systems developer emphasizing security, code optimization, and high-volume real-time transaction processing.  

Recent IT applications include Active Directory (AD) Data Warehouse, AD Tools Suite, Cloud API Gateway, AD Data Warehouse, EADP (Ent. Acct Disable Process), BGMS (Bulk Group Mgt Svc), various AD automation systems, disparate systems integration, and various IT utilities. Apps are written entirely in C# using .NET Core, .NET, and ASP.NET.

Specialties: Very strong design and analysis skills, a talent for high-performance algorithms, and a reputation for bullet-proof code and intuitive no-nonsense UIs.

Current roles: Development team lead of cloud infrastructure services group focusing on automation and security. Current position: Systems Design & Integration Specialist 4.
